description: Radxa Cubie A7Z (Allwinner A733), 1 GB LPDDR4 (the user's SKU), with Wi-Fi 6 and no Ethernet. A board record: Atlas flashes it from the A733's FEL download mode, an eGON SPL and U-Boot over USB, and writes the microSD card. The family (allwinner-fel) gives the shared download-mode method and steps. Written from Radxa's docs and the board schematic (V2.00); untested on this board.

ports: USB-C 2: USB 3.x OTG with DisplayPort Alt Mode
no USB Type-A port is listed

leds.name: LED2 (green, LED_EN)
leds.note: the only LED on the V2.00 schematic

camera.connectors: V2.00: two 4-lane MIPI CSI connectors, CAM1 and CAM2, 31-pin each. V1.10 and V1.11: one 4-lane CSI (UNCONFIRMED for those revisions; this record reads the V2.00 page)

storage_target_evidence: docs.radxa.com Cubie A7Z: a microSD (TF) slot; UFS is optional (up to 1 TB); no eMMC.
Atlas writes the microSD card (the SD target). The A7Z's SPI NOR is not stated (UNCONFIRMED), and Atlas does not write it.
instructions: Hold the U-Boot button before power-on, and connect a USB-C port of the board to this computer with a data cable (which port is UNCONFIRMED: see todo).
Power the board on, then release the U-Boot button.
The board appears as 1f3a:efe8 (Allwinner FEL). Atlas loads the SPL and U-Boot over FEL, writes the image to the microSD card, reads it back and restarts the board.

flash.fel_image: eGON SPL then legacy U-Boot (u-boot-sunxi-with-spl form), UNCONFIRMED for the A733

Gaia needs: the A733 FEL image (eGON SPL and U-Boot) as the loader, and the microSD disk image.
UNCONFIRMED: the LED's GPIO pin and polarity (LED_EN, the only LED on V2.00).
UNCONFIRMED: the camera connectors on V1.10 and V1.11 (one 4-lane CSI there, per the record's source note); the board's revision decides which applies.
UNCONFIRMED: whether an SPI NOR is fitted.
The eMMC is not fitted (none on this board), so the microSD is the storage target. Running, the board needs a Gaia image with board-lite; no Gaia board config for the Cubie exists yet.
